summary: Iter 60 · STMT-UI-1 v2 Phase 3 retest after the pdfjs-dist worker fix. The version pin (pdfjs-dist=4.8.69 exact, matching react-pdf 9.2.1's internal API) resolves the iter59 blocker: /app/statements/1e6f55e6-939e-49b9-a65d-bf8c39b5c2a9/compare now renders the real PDF pane instead of the 'Side-by-side comparison isn't available' fallback. Zero PDF.js API/Worker version-mismatch errors, zero console errors overall across all Phase 3 flows. Full Phase 3 coverage now GREEN: (1) compare-page renders with pdf-pane + decoded-pane + PDF canvas; (2) compare-figure-list has 1 row 'Care management fee $300.00 Match' and the divergence footer reads '1 match · 0 differ · 0 no-match' (total=1 >0 as required); (3) pdf-zoom-select has all 6 presets (50/75/100/125/150/Fit width) and each switch triggers a re-render without console errors, pdf-prev-page/pdf-next-page both disabled for numPages=1 as expected; (4) divider keyboard interaction is fully verified — inline width goes 50% → 35% after 3× ArrowLeft (correct 5%/step) and clamps at 30% after 20+ ArrowLeft, keyboard split logic within 30–70% is proven; (5) sync scroll toggle is checked by default and flips correctly, scrolling the decoded pane never throws; (6) mobile 390×844 hides the desktop split (display:none) and shows compare-tab-original / compare-tab-decoded both visible & clickable — tab swap works with no console errors; (7) decoder-share-pdf-btn on the detail page opens a popup whose body contains 'TestCare', 'charging', '3,300' and 'wayly.com.au' — inline script for window.print() is present. Backend regression: 45/45 pytest green (33 DEC-1 v7.7 + 12 iter59 STMT-UI-1 v2). Ready for Phase 3 sign-off.

critical_code_review_comments: pdfjs-dist is now pinned exactly to 4.8.69 in package.json — great, but add a package.json `resolutions`/`overrides` block if react-pdf ever bumps its internal pdfjs-dist to avoid another silent drift.

StatementCompare.jsx passes a hand-crafted viewport {transform:[1,0,0,-1,0,0]} to onPageTextLayer — token coordinates are approximate. The divergence match still succeeded on this fixture for the $300 care-management figure; if you introduce multi-page fixtures with fuzzy coords, revisit x/y normalisation.
The divider is a 6px-wide element (w-1.5) — accessible via keyboard (verified) but a bit hard to grab with imprecise pointers. Consider hit-slop padding or a wider drag hitbox for touch users.

onPageTextLayer setState via setTokensByPage in every Page render could re-trigger renders — check the useEffect that recomputes divergence doesn't cause an infinite loop on real multi-page PDFs (this fixture is 1 page so untested).

rca_of_the_issue: Fixed in this iter: package.json pins pdfjs-dist to exact '4.8.69' (matching react-pdf 9.2.1's bundled API). StatementCompare.jsx now imports { pdfjs } directly from 'pdfjs-dist' and sets GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc via `new URL('pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs', import.meta.url).toString()`, resolving to the same 4.8.69 worker. Result: pdfjs.version === worker version, `getDocument()` succeeds, `<Document>` fires onLoadSuccess with numPages=1, PDF canvas + text layer render, divergence map builds and the fallback branch is NOT entered.
